ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pigments (approx. 85%) with localized high-intensity white/light-grey zones (approx. 15%) concentrated at the distal lateral margins and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling located on the distal outer tips of both lobes; a broad, irregular white band is mapped to the right lobe's upper trailing edge, while a smaller, more concentrated white cluster is mapped to the left lobe's outer tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a calculated base vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jagged serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5-20 pixels in vertical amplitude across the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-concave curve originating from the median notch and terminating at the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several low-contrast greyish linear streaks or rake-like disruptions visible on the central dark surface area of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular focal indentation (light grey/white) positioned slightly to the right of the central median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular mottled 'salt and pepper' transition zone between the dark central pigment and white distal pigment on the right lobe's trailing edge.
